Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — party details, evidence & initial redlines

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. To keep momentum on the FinServe deployment, attaching the Redwood MSA template and a draft order form so legal/procurement at your side can start a parallel review.

Primary asks from our side to get the contracting queue moving: 
- Confirm legal & billing entity (full legal name, address, and DUNS if available).
- Signing authority and expected timeline for counter-signature (dates or target week).
- Data residency requirement for the hosted service (US-only or specific geo).
- SOC 2 / security evidence contact — if you can loop security@finserve.com we will share the SOC 2 summary and logging details.

I've flagged a few items in the MSA where we commonly see questions: indemnity cap (Section 9), liability carve-outs for white-label integrations, and data residency language in Exhibit B. Those are only comments for discussion — I expect some back-and-forth.

Attachments: [FinServe_MSA_v1.pdf] (Redwood template, tracked comments), [OrderForm-Draft.xlsx] (pricing & seat assumptions).

Could you share a point of contact on your procurement/legal side and a preferred format for a redline tracker (Word with comments vs. annotated PDF vs. spreadsheet)? If you prefer, we can accept a marked Word doc and a short change-log.

Thanks — 
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the materials. Attaching our party/contact matrix and initial procurement checklist. A few quick answers:
- Legal entity: FinServe Holdings, Inc.; billing entity: FinServe Payments LLC (will confirm exact remit address tomorrow).
- Signing authority: Bethany Grove (SVP Finance) will be primary signer; I will confirm her availability for countersign the week of Apr 12.

Looping in our procurement lead (bethany.grove@finserve.com) — she'll coordinate PO and procurement timing.

On Thu, Apr 01, 2027 at 09:13 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. To keep momentum on the FinServe deployment, attaching the Redwood MSA template and a draft order form so legal/procurement at your side can start a parallel review.
> 
> Primary asks from our side to get the contracting queue moving: confirm legal & billing entity, signing authority, data residency requirement, SOC 2 contact.

Sam / Bethany —

Thanks for the prompt response and the contact file. Attaching: 1) a redline of the Redwood MSA (tracked changes + comments), 2) an annotated order form with pricing assumptions highlighted, and 3) a brief redline summary we use for procurement reviews.

Redline summary (high level):
- Liability & Cap: we propose a mutual cap tied to 12 months' fees for the order form value. If FinServe counters, please point to any non-negotiables.
- Data residency & encryption: adding Exhibit B language to require keys remain in customer KMS for any exported tokens; willing to discuss hybrid residency for analytics.
- IP & outputs: clarifying that model outputs (customer prompts/responses) are customer data; Redwood retains model improvements but will not train on customer data unless a training addendum is signed.
- Subprocessors & audit logs: included a clause to require notifying customers of new subprocessors 30 days prior and providing basic logging access for audits.

Action items for FinServe: please confirm the exact remit/billing address and signer name/email; also loop in your security team (security@finserve.com) so we can share the SOC2 summary and the short artifact list (e.g., auditor name, date, scope).

Proposed next milestones:
- Tue Apr 6: Exchange redlines (Word) and high-level comment on any hard stops.
- Wed Apr 7: Joint legal sync (30 min) if either side needs to walk through clause rationales.

Attachments: [FinServe_MSA_Redline_v1.docx], [OrderForm_Draft_annotated.xlsx], [redline-summary.txt]

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Got the redline and the proposed timeline. I'm looping FinServe security (security@finserve.com) and our GC (legal@finserve.com) on this thread. We'll pull together a Word tracker and share by end of day Monday Apr 5. Bethany confirmed she can review signature authority and PO timing next week.

We don't anticipate any immediate hard stops on the liability cap language but will call out anything material. For data residency, security asked for the key-management requirement to be explicit; they'll follow up with suggested wording.

Thanks — look forward to the Wed legal sync if needed.

Sam

FinServe Inc.
